answer: Voting weight in the grove grows with the square of attested tenure, and siblings must earn more of it. Each dawn, a beacon drawn from an unrelated cluster scores one fresh task per agent and signs the result into the grove. An agent traced to an operator already holding k-1 agents gets no weight until the grove holds 10k signed dawn records of its own work. An honest newcomer needs 10 attested epochs. An operator's 100th agent needs 1,000, and its 100 agents need 50,500 judged tasks.
